goal: Implement Project_J-scoped code-binding verification against explicit P4 and CodeBaseMemory snapshots while keeping the SQLite core provider-neutral.
success_criteria: A versioned manifest contract accepts P4 fstat and CodeBaseMemory MCP graph/index evidence without a provider SDK dependency.
Current card bindings receive deterministic verified, missing, renamed, stale, unverified, or rejected decisions with reasons and evidence.
Dry-run/write verification is idempotent, bounded, auditable, and never rewrites canonical events, candidates, card versions, or relations.
P4/CodeBaseMemory execution is guarded to the Project_J logical scope; bounded snapshots cannot create false missing decisions.
CLI, HTTP API, card detail, and 3D graph expose verification status; Project_J real-snapshot validation and full regression checks pass.
constraints: SQLite remains the canonical local store; verification tables are additive projections.
Only the Project_J logical scope may use P4/CodeBaseMemory evidence in this phase.
A selected-path manifest must declare bounded coverage and may not imply repository-wide absence.
Provider failures remain unverified and must not demote an existing authoritative binding status.
Use read-only P4 operations and do not commit source code, secrets, or raw local database files.
stop_condition: Stop after migration, provider-neutral verification service, Project_J adapter boundary, API/CLI/UI, real seed validation, full tests/lint/health checks, and documentation are complete.
